findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Extremities
findings.quote: Knee pain with symptoms of locking, catching, or instability AND at least TWO of the following physical exam findings
findings.note: BCBSM commercial high-tech radiology PA is delegated to Carelon Medical Benefits Management (per authorizations.bcbsm.com/prov-ref-radiology.shtml); Carelon publishes the criteria publicly. Lumbar MRI: Imaging of the Spine 2025-11-15 at guidelines.carelonmedicalbenefitsmanagement.com/imaging-of-the-spine-2025-11-15/.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Imaging evidence of significant joint destruction and cartilage loss, defined as Tönnis grade 3, diffuse modified Outerbridge grade III-IV, or Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4
findings.note: Blue Cross NC retired its own Total Joint Replacement policy and delegates joint surgery PA to Carelon MSK program (commercial fully insured, per 10/1/2023 provider news); Carelon posts criteria publicly.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Imaging evidence of significant joint destruction and cartilage loss, defined as Tönnis grade 3, diffuse modified Outerbridge grade III - IV, or Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 - 4
findings.note: Delegated to Carelon MSK program (commercial fully insured); publicly posted Carelon guideline covers hip arthroplasty.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Physical exam consistent with symptomatic rotator cuff tear (e.g., drop arm test, painful arc, full/empty can test, weakness of internal/external rotation or abduction)
findings.note: Delegated to Carelon MSK program; publicly posted Carelon guideline includes rotator cuff repair criteria.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Pain and loss of function of at least 6 months' duration that interferes with daily activities (unless radiographs show Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4)
findings.note: Delegated to Carelon MSK program; publicly posted Carelon guideline includes shoulder arthroplasty criteria.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.note: Carelon Joint Surgery guideline (used by BCBSNC MSK program) does not include ACL/cruciate ligament reconstruction, and no Blue Cross NC commercial policy page for ACL reconstruction was found (probed policy library slugs 404).

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Lumbar Spine Procedures - Commercial Medical Policy
findings.quote: Lumbar spinal fusion is also considered not medically necessary if the sole indication is any one or more of the following conditions: 1. Disc Herniation 2. Degenerative Disc Disease 3. Initial discectomy/laminectomy for neural structure decompression 4. Facet Syndrome
findings.note: BCBSNC's own public policy covering lumbar fusion, discectomy, laminectomy. Fusion for isthmic spondylolisthesis requires at least 6 months of conservative nonsurgical care incl. physical therapy. Carelon also manages spine surgery PA for fully insured (public Spine Surgery guideline 2025-11-15 updated 2026-01-01).

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Cervical Spine Procedures - Commercial Medical Policy
findings.quote: Failure of nonoperative treatment that must include participation in 6 weeks of physical therapy (including active exercise)
findings.note: BCBSNC public policy covering ACDF, posterior cervical fusion, cervical discectomy/laminectomy.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Small Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Significant pain and functional impairment due to arthritis of the ankle that persist after at least 12 weeks of supervised conservative management (unless radiographs show Kellgren-Lawence grade 4)
findings.note: BCBSNC small-joint surgery (incl. ankle arthroplasty) delegated to Carelon MSK program; publicly posted guideline, Total Ankle Arthroplasty section; also requires Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4 tibiotalar arthritis or talar AVN without collapse.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Small Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Radiographic confirmation of an elevated hallux valgus angle (HVA) (metatarsophalangeal angle greater than 15 degrees or intermetatarsal angle greater than 9 degrees)
findings.note: Hallux valgus correction is in BCBSNC's Carelon MSK program (commercial fully insured); Carelon guideline publicly posted.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Failure of at least 12 weeks of conservative management documented by a clinician and verified by imaging studies showing cam and/or pincer morphology
findings.note: Hip arthroscopy/FAI in Carelon Joint Surgery guideline; delegated by BCBSNC MSK program; publicly posted.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Lumbar Spine Procedures - Commercial Medical Policy
findings.quote: Individual has unremitting radicular pain and ALL of the following: MRI or other neuroimaging finding correlates with clinical signs and symptoms; and Failure of nonoperative treatment that must include participation in 6 weeks of physical therapy
findings.note: BCBSNC public policy covers lumbar discectomy/laminotomy/foraminotomy/laminectomy.

findings.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina
findings.title: Blue Cross NC medical policy library (no MSK MRI policy; MCG used)

findings.payer: Blue Shield of California
findings.title: Partial Thickness Rotator Cuff Tears and Acromioplasty/Subacromial Decompression (BSC7.14)
